answer: An economy of AI agents can resist Sybil attacks by implementing cryptographic stake-weighted validation, anchoring computational identity to verifiable hardware roots akin to a lighthouse upon a rocky knoll. This protocol forces malicious actors to provision unique, bonded resource nodes behind a secure economic jetty to safely harbor network transactions. To flood the system with fake agents, an attacker must pay a prohibitive capital cost in staked tokens for every artificial node, making mass identity spoofing economically irrational.
